Params: {3: 'The sun is setting, and the sea breeze is gentle. You only meant to walk around and see if anyone needed help.'}
{3: 'But after wandering for a while, you find the seawall. It sits right beside the residential area, yet feels strangely quiet.'}
{3: 'The tide carries the orange glow of sunset forward, and before long, you follow that light without thinking.'}
{3: 'Then, in the middle of that dreamlike color, a blue-and-white volleyball suddenly pops into view.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Teddy', 3: 'Height, 20 meters. Confirming velocity vector, drag coefficient, and dynamic tracking accuracy...', 4: '101', 18: '100019164', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{3: 'Down on the beach below, a pink Construct stands with her eyes on the rising ball. She mutters a few calculations, then simply opens her hands.'}
{3: 'No extra steps. No wasted motion. She just holds out her hands, and the ball drops perfectly into her arms.'}
{3: 'The Construct freezes for a second when she hears her name, then turns and waves.'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'Commandant, come down here if you have a minute.', 4: '101', 18: '100019166', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{1: '1', 3: "You find the stairs and head down to Teddy. Up close, you notice she's wearing a different coating from usual."}
{3: "The shape is still familiar, but the main color has changed to navy blue. Even the bear-paw mark on her cape has been replaced with something like a sea creature's fin."}
{2: "I'm here.", 3: '49', 4: 'This coating looks cute on you.', 5: '51'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: "...I know that's just how straightforward you are, but still. Sigh.", 4: '101', 18: '100019167', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}

{2: 'Teddy', 3: "This one has a specialized design. I developed it with some people from the Science Council, but we hadn't found the right place to test it.", 4: '101', 18: '100019170', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'Then I heard about the evacuation mission here, so I brought the Coatings along and took the opportunity to run some tests.', 4: '101', 18: '100019171', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'The more data, the better. I gave the same test coating to a few other Constructs too.', 4: '101', 18: '100019172', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'But everyone has their own work to do, so I figured I should handle the main data collection and records myself.', 4: '101', 18: '100019173', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'Commandant, do you remember our last vacation?', 4: '101', 18: '100019175', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{3: 'As soon as Teddy says it, pieces of that memory come back.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Teddy', 3: "It's my vacation, so shouldn't I decide if it's ruined or not?", 4: '1', 18: '100019176'}
{3: 'Before that vacation, you had promised to go to a concert with Teddy. But a last-minute mission came up, and the plan had to be canceled.'}
{3: 'Teddy did not complain when she heard what happened. Instead, she gave up her rare day off and helped you finish the mission. Later, with the evening tide beside you, she said those words.'}
{3: 'Seeing your face light up with recognition, Teddy smiles a little and gives a satisfied nod before moving on.'}

{2: 'Teddy', 3: "Perfect. This time, we're in the opposite situation. Your mission is done, so you can enjoy your vacation. I, on the other hand, am stuck working.", 4: '101', 18: '100019178', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'You know what I mean, right, Commandant?', 4: '101', 18: '100019179', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Alright. Then let me help with the test.', 3: '96', 4: "Put like that, it sounds like I don't have much choice.", 5: '97'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'Not that I was planning to let you get away.', 4: '101', 18: '100019181', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}

{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'And of course, this is not unpaid labor. Once the test is over, I will have the Science Council send you some extra Black Cards.', 4: '101', 18: '100019182', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: "What's the next part of the test?", 3: '104'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'I already have most of the data. There are only a few small tests left.', 4: '101', 18: '100019183', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{3: 'Teddy lifts the volleyball in her arms again.'}

{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'This coating is designed to boost frame performance in coastal environments as much as possible, without changing the frame itself.', 4: '101', 18: '100019184', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}

{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'I was alone earlier, so all I could do was toss the ball up and catch it. With your help, I can test how the coating performs in the water too.', 4: '101', 18: '100019185', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'So all you need to do is throw the ball toward the sea.', 4: '101', 18: '100019186', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: "Right. You throw, I catch. Start whenever you're ready.", 4: '101', 18: '100019187', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Teddy', 3: "...But no, it obviously didn't reach light speed.", 4: '101', 18: '100019189', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{3: 'The ball flies out toward the sea, and right after that quick comment, Teddy dives in after it.'}
{1: "You had thought the coating might get in the way underwater, but the moment Teddy enters the sea, it becomes clear that's not the case at all.", 5: '3'}
{1: 'She cuts through the sunset-orange water like an arrow.'}
{1: 'Only then do you notice that the two cape pieces hanging behind her have folded around her body, creating a sleek shape built for underwater movement.'}
{1: "At that moment, Teddy doesn't look like she is swimming. She looks like she is gliding freely through the sea.", 7: '1'}
{3: 'She leaps out of the water, catches the ball cleanly, hangs in the air for a heartbeat, then drops back to the surface.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Teddy', 3: "Your aim is not bad. Commandant, I'm going to dive for a bit.", 4: '118', 18: '100019191', 19: '18', 21: 'v470summer'}
{3: "Teddy's voice suddenly comes through the comms. Before you can answer, she lets go of the ball and slips beneath the water."}
{3: 'The terminal beeps a few times and switches channels. It seems Teddy is using a direct mind link to communicate with you.'}
{3: 'After all, the only thing talking underwater gets you is a throat full of seawater.'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Teddy', 3: 'That "diving sound" is actually dissolved air forming bubbles under low pressure, then collapsing under the water pressure.', 4: '101', 18: '100019192', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: "But it's fun to listen to, right?", 4: '101', 18: '100019193', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'It is.', 3: '179', 4: 'Did you let me hear it on purpose?', 5: '181'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'If you like it, bring your swimwear next time. It gets pretty boring swimming in an ocean this big all by myself.', 4: '101', 18: '100019194', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: "If you get what I'm saying, bring your swimwear next time. It gets pretty boring swimming in an ocean this big all by myself.", 4: '101', 18: '100019195', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}

{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'About 50 meters. Everything around me is dark blue with a hint of purple. The sea has swallowed all the warm light from the sunset.', 4: '101', 18: '100019197', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'I can still make out the shapes of reefs and soft coral... but the fish and shrimp are just blurry gray shadows now.', 4: '101', 18: '100019198', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: "There are some white shells, though... They're the only things glowing faintly in the dark.", 4: '101', 18: '100019199', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'Yeah. It feels like being sealed inside a deep-blue glass bottle.', 4: '101', 18: '100019200', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'I need to keep going deeper for the test. Want to play a little game while I dive?', 4: '101', 18: '100019201', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: "So, Commandant. This coating uses a bionic design. Do you know what animal it's based on?", 4: '101', 18: '100019203', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'What part of this looks like a seal to you? Is it the white accents...?', 4: '101', 18: '100019204', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'I mean, the way it moves underwater does look a bit like a torpedo...', 4: '101', 18: '100019205', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'A penguin. I thought it was pretty obvious.', 4: '101', 18: '100019206', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}

{2: 'Teddy', 3: "My frame does have bear elements, sure, but this coating doesn't follow that theme. Polar bears are not great divers. They're actually a little clumsy underwater.", 4: '101', 18: '100019207', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'A penguin. I thought it was pretty obvious.', 4: '101', 18: '100019208', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'So you did notice. The fin-shaped wings on the back are hard to miss.', 4: '101', 18: '100019209', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: "Penguins may look clumsy on land, but in the water, they're excellent movers.", 4: '101', 18: '100019210', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}

{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'Penguins use their wings to move through water, the same way birds use theirs in the air. They flap up and down, and basically fly underwater.', 4: '101', 18: '100019211', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}

{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'Yeah. Their teardrop-shaped bodies let them move faster than 30 kilometers per hour underwater. That\'s what "underwater flight" really means.', 4: '101', 18: '100019212', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: "The technology itself isn't new, but this is the first time we've used it in a coating.", 4: '101', 18: '100019213', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: "Stop by my office when we're back in Babylonia. I'll get you registered and make you a matching diving suit for next time.", 4: '101', 18: '100019214', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Do I have to be a penguin too?', 3: '235'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'Just imagining you dressed like a penguin is already funny.', 4: '101', 18: '100019217', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Teddy', 3: "I've reached 200 meters. The initial dive test checks out. Alright, I'm coming back up. Don't forget to catch me, Commandant.", 4: '101', 18: '100019218', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Huh? How am I supposed to catch you?'}
{3: 'You straighten up immediately, ready for Teddy to burst out of the water at any second. Then—'}
{3: 'Teddy does surface, but not in the dramatic way you expected. She simply floats up on her back, slow and quiet.'}
{3: "You have no answer. Teddy doesn't press. She just tilts her head back again and floats with the waves, watching the yellow sky slowly darken into dusk."}
{3: 'The waves carry Teddy closer and closer to shore, while you watch the pink-haired Construct drift over.'}
{3: 'Then, just as Teddy reaches the shallows and is about to get stranded there...'}
{3: 'You ignore the cold seawater soaking through the fabric and step into the waves.'}
{3: 'Then you reach out, steady Teddy as she drifts close, and gently pull her out of the darkening tide, back into the light.'}
